title: El cilindro
goal: Order a gas cylinder and be in when it comes
culture: Cooking gas comes in a cylinder you swap, delivered off the back of a truck. There is no pipe and no account, and delivery is simply two people agreeing to be in the same place at the same time.

beats.good: Gas arrives on a truck with a loudspeaker and you buy it by shouting back. There is no pipe to any house on this street.
Twenty-five pounds is the household one and one person can carry it. The hundred is for a comedor.

beats.en: What time will you bring it?
ok: a que hora me lo trae
beats.good: Ask, because somebody has to open the door and hand over the empty one, and that somebody is you.

beats.es: Como a las tres de la tarde.
beats.good: Aquí estoy — I will be here. That is the whole of the delivery contract and both halves of it are spoken.
